paraphrase: The ten major precepts of the bodhisattva: not to kill, steal, engage in sexual misconduct, lie, sell intoxicants, speak of the faults of the fourfold assembly, praise oneself and disparage others, be stingy, be angry and refuse apology, or slander the three jewels; with forty-eight minor precepts, including not eating meat; all beings who receive the precepts enter the rank of buddhas.
